trades.reasoning: All four confirmation signals align — RSI 69.2 in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge — indicating strong institutional participation despite a flat broader market.

decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.4%), not a risk-on day, so we're not force-deploying all remaining cash. PGEN stood out as the one candidate with full multi-signal confirmation (momentum, trend, and volume all aligned), so we're adding it with high conviction while holding the rest of our cash and existing positions steady.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, a mild pullback rather than a broad risk-off move. Trading was largely rotational, with money shifting between sectors rather than fleeing equities altogether. No major catalyst drove the modest decline, consistent with a market pausing after recent gains.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市略為下跌，納指跌0.1%，標普500跌0.4%，屬溫和回調而非全面risk-off。資金似乎在板塊之間輪動，而非大舉撤出股市。今日跌幅未見明顯導火線，較似是市場在近期升勢後稍作喘息。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of relying on one indicator, strong traders look for several signals to line up together — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and volume — before making a high-conviction bet. When all four agree, it's a much stronger signal than any single one alone, especially on an otherwise quiet market day.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 強勢的交易者不會只靠單一指標，而是尋找多個訊號同時出現——例如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢同成交量——先出手落重注。當四個訊號一致時，遠比單一訊號可靠，尤其係喺大市平靜嘅日子更加明顯。
